integrity: The proof, exact coefficient identity, and diagnostic checker are supplied in this package. Finite checks are not substituted for the analytical proof.
scientific_limitations: Uniqueness and refined inverse-scale asymptotics are specific to deterministic positive Poisson jump sizes; the general support-endpoint limit requires nonzero spectrally positive bounded Lévy measure. Full text of arXiv:2609.23069v1 was inaccessible; an independent priority assessment has not been performed.
title: A sharp Gaussian-noise transition for optimal sub-gamma scales
